def send_status(status: 'Status'):
    """
    Deliver a status to the destination channel.

    Args:
        status (Status): The status
    """
    global middlewares, master
    if status is None:
        return

    s: 'Optional[Status]' = status

    # Go through middlewares
    for i in middlewares:
        s = i.process_status(cast('Status', s))
        if s is None:
            return

    status = cast('Status', s)

    status.verify()

    status.destination_channel.send_status(status)

                f"MIME ({self.mime!r}) is not valid."
            # Upstream type definition issue in python/typeshed

            # Current mypy 0.790 includes typeshed from 28 Aug 2020 (5be9c71)
            # https://github.com/python/mypy/tree/v0.790/mypy
            # Fixed typeshed commit is on 27 Sep 2020 (076983e)
            # https://github.com/python/typeshed/commit/076983eec45e739c68551cb6119fd7d85fd4afa9

    """

def get_base_path() -> Path:
    """
    Get the base data path for EFB. This can be defined by the

    ``~/.ehforwarderbot``.

    This method creates the queried path if not existing.

    env_data_path = os.environ.get("EFB_DATA_PATH", None)
    if env_data_path:

    else:
